# Dayloop v0.15.1 — P5R polish update

Dayloop v0.15.1 is a stable post-milestone update for the Persona 5 Royal pack. It keeps the v0.15.0 milestone architecture and route contract intact while shipping the visual, presentation, and content corrections merged since that release.

## Highlights

- Refined the P5R Today screen with the final Day/Night artwork treatment, improved task presentation, corrected date-header sizing, and safer one-line date fitting.
- Repurposed the Shujin answer artwork as a right-anchored, faded background inside the Answer banner so the answer text stays readable without wasting horizontal space.
- Improved P5R Mementos Requests presentation, including 75%-opaque request panels and a counter banner aligned with the Achievements tracker.
- Expanded and corrected P5R achievement presentation and completion placement, with additional achievement artwork and regression coverage.
- Refined Confidant presentation and bundled additional P5R tarot/character artwork while preserving task-derived progression.
- Updated the P5R bundled content stamp to `contentVersion 14` for the deliberate post-milestone content changes.

## Compatibility

- Existing profiles and progress remain supported.
- P3R and Metaphor remain pack-isolated; this release does not intentionally change their route data or progression behavior.
- The P5R v0.15.0 milestone remains the documented reference boundary; v0.15.1 is an explicit P5R correction/polish release on top of it.

## Validation

- Stable Android release APK assembly.
- APK signature verification with `apksigner`.
- App, core-pack, core-progress, and pack-tool unit tests.
- `packlint` validation for P5R, P3R, and Metaphor.
- GitHub Actions stable-release workflow publishes the verified APK only after the release branch is merged to `main`.

Fan-made companion tool; not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA.
